name: Can I live in my home during an interior renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during an interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can remain in your home during an interior renovation depends on the scope of the project. Minor renovations in a single room might allow you to stay, with proper dust and safety precautions. However, extensive projects like a full kitchen or multiple bathrooms often make it impractical or unsafe. This is a practical tradeoff; staying might save on temporary housing but could lead to inconvenience and longer project times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living in your home during renovation depends on project scope. Minor work may allow it, but extensive projects often make it impractical, requiring a temporary move.
